cohort: Pregnant individuals with oligohydramnios in their third trimester receiving care at a tertiary hospital in Pakistan.
finding: A significant association was found between oligohydramnios and anaemia in the third trimester of pregnancy.
mod_finding: A high proportion (81.6%) of pregnant individuals with oligohydramnios and anaemia underwent cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight, extremely low birth weight
